_doc: Music cuts, in seconds of the file (Suno aligned lyrics give the times). in/out = the part that plays; fade = fade-out at the end; sungEnd = when the last sung word ends (an intro theme's speech starts 0.4 s after it). A bed has just a file and loops. Keys are used in film.json: parts[…].bed, scenes[…].intro / .after. gain = dB on top of the mix level, to even out a take that measures quiet or loud in the master (keep jingle/ballad volume ≤ 1: JINGLE is 0.95, so at most +0.44).
